name: Casa Bianco
beschreibung:
Overview

Apart Casa Bianco is an apartment house in Sölden in the Ötztal in Tyrol. It is located at Innerwaldstraße 23 on a hillside above the village centre, directly on the ski slopes, and according to the operator offers ski-in & ski-out directly from the house onto the piste. The Gaislachkoglbahn cable car is in the immediate vicinity, and the village centre is about one kilometre away. The house comprises two modern and bright apartments with generous amenities. Every bedroom has satellite TV and its own bathroom with hairdryer; access to the balcony or terrace is possible from every bedroom. A fully equipped kitchenette completes the offering. Further amenities include internet access and a ski cellar with boot dryer. According to the operator, guests have free parking and free Wi-Fi available. The sunny, quiet location above the village centre and the proximity to restaurants and cafés make the house a starting point for winter and summer holidays.

History/Background

Apart Casa Bianco is run by Alexandra Arnold. Owner or founding details are not given on the property's own website, so no further verified information can be provided. It is documented that the establishment is a partner of the Ötztal Inside Summer Card and thereby offers its summer guests the premium benefits of this card.

Getting there

According to the operator, arriving by car goes from the Dorfstraße in Sölden to the junction of the Gletscherstraße, then along the Gletscherstraße to exit "N2" in the direction of Innerwald. Follow exit N2 until the house is visible on the right-hand side. Free parking is available at the house. From the village centre, the house can be reached in a few minutes on foot with the Zentrumsshuttle. The exact address is Innerwaldstraße 23, 6450 Sölden.

Tips

Those arriving in winter benefit from the direct access to the slopes (ski-in & ski-out); skis, snowboards and boots can be stored in the ski cellar with boot dryer. For an additional charge, the establishment offers fresh rolls daily from the village bakery, which can be ordered via QR code. Payment is accepted in cash only – credit and debit cards are not accepted. The deposit is 30% of the total price, final cleaning is 100 euros per apartment. Check-in is possible from 15:00, check-out until 9:00; for late arrival the establishment should be informed in good time. Pets are not allowed. The local tax is 5.00 euros.

Best time to travel

The Ötztal and Sölden offer holiday opportunities all year round. In winter, according to the operator, the Sölden ski area extends from 1,350 m to 3,340 m in altitude and comprises around 33 modern lift facilities and 31 ski huts. In summer, according to its own description, mountain panoramas, bike and hiking tours as well as alpine huts are the attractions; the Ötztal Inside Summer Card is included in the offer.
